title: DAO vector claims DODAGID but encodes the no-DODAGID form
description: Correctness review: test/vectors/rpl_messages.json:122-132 names dao_base and describes Base RPL DAO with DODAGID, but encoded is only 00000005 (the 4-byte no-D form), flags are zero, and dodag_id is null. test/vectors/generate.py:2552-2557 has the same contradiction. A DAO with DODAGID must set D (kd_flags bit 6) and append 16 bytes (20-byte base), as spec/03-adaptation.md:102-105 states. Either rename/document this as the no-DODAGID fallback case or encode the claimed form.
